limitations: Center-slice finite-polynomial zeros only; beyond degree four exact transition loci are not classified. Near-circle complex zeros may lie outside the ellipse. Earlier general planar kernel zero theorems may affect originality.
scientific_integrity: Planar Chebyshev orthogonality and finite kernel are prior; only zero migration and first exact transition are claimed as new. Same-model proof review only, no independent audit.
title: Real-to-nonreal zeros in finite Bergman kernels of ellipses: the first sharp bifurcation
